name: @tenure/configuration
description: Layered, governed configuration resolution. Organization-specific behaviour without organization-specific code.
//: Source is consumed directly — no build step. apps/web lists this in next.config.ts transpilePackages, and its tsconfig maps the package name to src/index.ts. A dist/ would mean a build ordering problem and a stale-artifact failure mode for no benefit at this size.
//dependencies: @tenure/finops owns the money: ConfigDefinition.price and ResolvedConfig.runningCost are its types and its arithmetic (NEXT-SESSION §7). The dependency runs one way — finops imports nothing from here — so a price cannot grow a dependency on a resolver.
